output.summary: BCBS's Basel III monitoring shows stable capital, Group 1 LCR 136.6%, NSFR 123.3%; Fed's Bowman flags final stress-test revisions soon; UBS capital dispute with Swiss minister continues.

citations.quote: The weighted average LCR increased compared with the previous reporting period to 136.6% for Group 1 banks. The weighted average NSFR decreased slightly to 123.3% for Group 1 banks.
